definitions.explanation: A person who takes on the role of listening in a conversation, or the act of serving as the listener rather than the speaker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{徹|てっ}した→徹する：12567_tessuru⟧。
examples.english: Today I devoted myself to being the listener.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧だ。
examples.english: He's the type who always ends up being the listener.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}→信頼関係：16095_shinraikankei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{築|きず}く→築く：02046_kizuku⟧⟦{第一歩|だいいっぽ}→第一歩：09671_daiippo⟧だ。
examples.english: Being a good listener is the first step in building a relationship of trust.

notes:
A compound noun from ⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (to listen) + ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role). Refers to the person who primarily listens in a conversation, or the act of taking on that role. In Japanese communication, being a good {聞|き}き{役|やく} is considered an important social skill.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{徹|てっ}する→徹する：12567_tessuru⟧ — to devote oneself to listening
- {聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ — to take on the role of listener
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{聞|き}き{役|やく} — a good listener
- {聞|き}き{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become the listener

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ — the speaker role; the counterpart to {聞|き}き{役|やく}
- ⟦{相槌|あいづち}→相槌：10916_aizuchi⟧ — conversational back-channeling; a key skill for being a good {聞|き}き{役|やく}
